Algorithm 1: Join1D (X, Y, ε)

Input : two 1-dimensional datasets  \( X = \{x_{1}, \cdots, x_{n}\} \)  and  \( Y = \{y_{1}, \cdots, y_{m}\} \)  in ascending order and a parameter ε

Output : the result of  \( X \bowtie_{\epsilon} Y \) 

1  \( XY \leftarrow \emptyset; l \leftarrow 1; r \leftarrow 0; \) 

2 for each  \( x_{i} \)  from 1 to n in the ascending order do

3 while  \( l \leq m \)  and  \( y_{l} < x_{i} - \epsilon \)  do  \( l \leftarrow l + 1; \) 

4 while  \( r + 1 \leq m \)  and  \( y_{r+1} \leq x_{i} + \epsilon \)  do  \( r \leftarrow r + 1; \) 

5  \( J_{i} \leftarrow \{y_{l}, \cdots, y_{r}\}; \) 

6 if  \( l \leq r \)  then  \( XY \leftarrow XY \cup (\{x_{i}\} \times J_{i}); \) 

7 return XY
